GitHub - vadimdemedes/ink-ui: Ink-redible command-line interfaces made easy

name: Ink UI
summary: Collection of themed React components for building command-line interfaces with Ink.
description: Components for terminal UIs built with Ink: text, email, password and confirm inputs, select and multi select, spinner, progress bar, badge, status message, alert, and ordered and unordered lists. Every component's styles live in a theme that can be customized or replaced via extendTheme and ThemeProvider. MIT licensed, with per-component documentation.
contains: 13 components: text/email/password/confirm inputs, select, multi select, spinner, progress bar, badge, alert, lists
theming via theme files, extendTheme and ThemeProvider
